answer: The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in oasis, expire in thread, and shale lists each expiry. An farming party running 52 aliases as a result needs 149 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4605 identities would post 743 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
